HelloTracksAPIKeyCredential.title: Hello Tracks API Key
HelloTracksAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste an API key from More → API & Integrations in the Hello Tracks dashboard. The key is sent in the API-Key header. Your account role and company settings control which operations are allowed.

HelloTracksArchiveJobConfig.description: Archives the job: it leaves the lists unless includeArchived=true and can be restored. Returns the job in `items`. An unknown or deleted id gives an empty list: a deleted job stays deleted, and restore is the way back.
HelloTracksArchiveJobConfig.title: HelloTracksArchiveJobConfig

HelloTracksCreateJobsConfig.description:
Creates one job (the job object as the body) or several (`{"jobs": [...]}`).

A job whose externalId matches an existing job of the company is updated with the fields sent instead of creating a duplicate (upsert), and is set back to normal if it was archived. A job that was deleted in Hellotracks stays deleted: it is not changed, and the answer lists it with `status: "deleted"`. The answer lists one job per job sent, in the same order.

Jobs without a location get the location of their place, else their address is geocoded in the background, so the response can still show location 0/0. Jobs that are assigned and dated drop the worker's saved route for that day, workers get the updated jobs, and the company's job webhooks fire. Unknown fields are refused with 400.

externalId.title: Externalid

address.description: Geocoded in the background when no location is given.
address.title: Address

placeId.description: Link the job to a place. A job without location takes the place's location, a job without title the place's name.
placeId.title: Placeid

assigneeId.description: Member id to assign. An empty string unassigns. Do not send together with assigneeUsername.
assigneeId.title: Assigneeid

assigneeUsername.description: Member username to assign. An unknown username is ignored. Do not send together with assigneeId.
assigneeUsername.title: Assigneeusername

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. An empty string removes the date; null leaves it as it is.
date.title: Date

onSiteDurationSeconds.description: Non-negative integer (or digits as a string).
onSiteDurationSeconds.title: Onsitedurationseconds

customFields.description: Replaces the job's whole set of custom fields: names left out are removed. Values are stored as text.
customFields.title: Customfields

HelloTracksListJobsConfig.description:
Lists the company's jobs.

Two modes:
- **Day list** (none of limit, skip, createdSince, updatedSince, progress): the jobs of one day, `date` or today in the caller's time zone, ordered by route position, at most 5,000. Archived jobs only with includeArchived=true.
- **Paged list** (any of limit, skip, createdSince, updatedSince, progress): all dates unless `date` is given, newest first (by last save, or by creation with createdSince), `limit` default 100, with totalCount and hasMore. Archived jobs are left out unless includeArchived=true.

Deleted jobs never come back. Looking up by `id` or `externalId` returns the job whatever its archive status and ignores date and assignee; no match gives an empty list.

Workers without the company setting workersViewJobCalendar may only list today (give or take four hours); other dates give 403.

externalId.description: Only the job with this externalId. No match returns an empty list with totalCount 0.
externalId.title: Externalid

date.description: Day of the jobs, YYYY-MM-DD. An empty value lists jobs without a date. Default: today in the day list, all dates in the paged list.
date.title: Date

allDates.description: Search across all dates (used with text).
allDates.title: Alldates

assigneeId.description: Only jobs of this member. An empty value lists unassigned jobs. Not together with assigneeUsername.
assigneeId.title: Assigneeid

assigneeUsername.description: Only jobs of the member with this username. An empty value lists unassigned jobs. Not together with assigneeId.
assigneeUsername.title: Assigneeusername

progress.description: Only jobs in this progress state. Switches to the paged list.
progress.title: Progress

text.description: Case-insensitive search in title, address and notes; also matches a job id, an order number or a job group name.
text.title: Text

createdSince.description: ms timestamp: only jobs created at or after it, newest created first. Switches to the paged list.
createdSince.title: Createdsince

updatedSince.description: ms timestamp: only jobs saved at or after it. Switches to the paged list.
updatedSince.title: Updatedsince

limit.description: Page size of the paged list. Switches to the paged list.
limit.title: Limit

skip.description: Jobs to skip in the paged list. Switches to the paged list.
skip.title: Skip

HelloTracksListMembersConfig.description: Lists the company's active members the key may see: admins and company keys see everyone; operators and workers see what the company's visibility settings allow (for example only their own team). The caller is always included. Removed members appear only when asked for by id. No paging: query and max filter the full list.

uids.title: Uids

query.description: Case-insensitive text found in id, username, name or email.
query.title: Query

max.description: At most this many members; no limit by default.
max.title: Max

Days are in the caller's time zone; an entry belongs to the day it starts. There is no paging and no limit on the range. Admins, operators and the company key may call it; workers get 403.

HelloTracksOptimizeRouteConfig.description: Optimizes the order of one member's jobs on one day and saves the route. Allowed for admins, dispatchers and the company; workers only when the company allows workersOptimizeRoute (403 otherwise, also for a member the caller cannot see). With solve=false a worker's route that was optimized in the last 3 hours is returned unchanged.

accountId.description: Member id or username whose route to optimize. Required unless account is sent.
accountId.title: Accountid

account.description: Same as accountId (member id or username). Wins when both are sent.
account.title: Account

solve.description: true runs the full solver (time windows, working hours, skills, capacity; jobs that do not fit come back in unassigned). false only reorders the stops.
solve.title: Solve

index.description: With count: optimize only the stops from this position on.
index.title: Index

count.description: With index: number of stops to optimize.
count.title: Count

constraints.description: Solver constraints (with solve=true). Keys are snake_case. Each defaults to on.
